sentences.text: Jared Corey Kushner -LRB- born January 10 , 1981 -RRB- is an American real estate investor and developer , newspaper owner , and senior advisor to President Donald Trump .	Donald Trump	Donald Trump	senior advisor	Senior Advisor to the President of the United States
Kushner is the elder son of real-estate developer Charles Kushner and is married to Trump 's daughter Ivanka .	Charles Kushner	Charles Kushner	Ivanka	Ivanka Trump

He was principal owner of the real-estate holding and development company Kushner Companies and of Observer Media , publisher of the New York Observer .	holding	holding company	development	real estate development	Kushner Companies	Kushner Companies	Observer Media	Observer Media	New York Observer	New York Observer
He is the co-founder and part owner of Cadre , an online real-estate investment platform .	Cadre	Cadre (company)
On January 9 , 2017 , Kushner was named as a senior White House advisor .
He consequently resigned as CEO of Kushner Companies and as publisher of the Observer , but his private financial interests remain a subject of controversy .	Kushner Companies	Kushner Companies
Kushner helped develop and run Trump 's digital media strategy .
